_comment: Every angle the corpus should explore for GEV. Each angle fans out to arXiv, OpenAlex (which indexes IEEE), DuckDuckGo web + news, YouTube and RSS. Sources are tiered so the mismatch engine knows primary from commentary. Queries are plain keyword strings; the pipeline appends nothing. Angles added 2026-09-20 afternoon cover the audit's items 3, 6-12.
